fields.finding: MOISTURE.csv annual_water_throughput_kg and CARD's 458.7 kg/year equal coupon permeation alone. Daily calculations include seam leakage; the annual field does not.
fields.evidence: At either 041 point, coupon-only 458.672527424 kg/year; adding the declared 305/50/10-day water weighting under the same nominal-pressure convention gives 459.261468067 kg/year. Continuous hot-leak upper envelope gives 461.780431057 kg/year, before initial residual water.
